name: Carnivore public website
summary: a scroll-driven introduction to Carnivore, persistent sessions and access from your phone, with the verified public macOS download, and a one-line terminal installer with a pinned checksum.
how_to: Read the product introduction and explore the labeled session-continuity illustration.
Follow download for macos to the pinned public release, or read source and legal information.

Paste curl -fsSL https://carnivore.ai/install.sh | bash into Terminal (the copy button is under the download button) to install the missing dependencies and the checksum-verified release, then launch it.
To remove carnivore, run bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://carnivore.ai/uninstall.sh)" in Terminal (add --dry-run to only see the list). It asks before removing anything.
examples: Leave the desk in the illustration: the viewer path disconnects while the running-session path remains.
media_exempt: The standalone public package is validated on its own local origin with desktop, phone, reduced-motion, no-JavaScript and interaction captures. The in-app feature-capture slot serves the application, not this separate public document.
